reply.text: This is a nutrition question about a technique, not a training question I can answer with their numbers, so no lookup is needed. Chew-and-spit is a way to get the taste of food without swallowing the calories. For training, it makes no difference to the session itself: lifting and running are fine whatever you're eating, as long as you're eating enough to get through the work. The real question is whether cutting intake that way leaves you short on protein and fuel for the training you're doing. I can't set a calorie target or tell you how much to eat; the app works that out on its Targets screen from your weight, activity and goal. If you want, I can also check your recent sessions to see how your training is holding up.
